KM45-10 Compact Joint Module

The KM45-10 is the smallest module in the KM series, built for grippers, wrists and small quadrupeds.

Specifications

Parameter Value
Rated voltage 24 V
Rated torque1 1.6 N·m
Peak torque 4.8 N·m
Rated speed 260 rpm
Gear ratio 10:1
Weight 185 g

Wiring

  • Red: V+ (18–28 V)
  • Black: GND
  • Yellow: CAN H
  • Green: CAN L

The module ships with CAN ID 1. Change it over the bus before you daisy-chain a second module.

1 At 25 °C ambient with the housing mounted on an aluminium plate.
